name: youtube-noti
title: YouTube Live Streams
description: See which of your YouTubers are live, upcoming, or recently ended
author: haikal_akif

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: YouTube API Key
preferences.description: Create at Google Cloud Console. Enable YouTube Data API v3.

preferences.name: channelIds
preferences.title: Channel IDs
preferences.description: One per line or comma-separated. Ignored if Channel IDs file is set.

preferences.name: channelIdsFile
preferences.title: Channel IDs file (for 20+ channels)
preferences.description: Optional .txt file with one channel ID per line.

commands.name: holo
commands.title: Stream
commands.description: See who's live, upcoming, or recently ended from your channel list
commands.subtitle: YouTube

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
